The CBSE 10th English syllabus for the academic year 2023-24 does not have many changes when compared to the 2022-23 syllabus. English is all about prose, poetry, and grammar. If students are good with their grammatical skills, they can easily score good marks in their English exams, uplifting their overall percentile score. The CBSE syllabus for Class 10 English for the academic year 2023-24 is framed in accordance with CBSE Board guidelines. Also, English Language and Literature and Communicative English syllabus work as a guide for theCBSE Class 10board students.
